Ashley R: Quick check — I'm about to apply a Terraform change that adds a ServiceAccount + RoleBinding for ExternalSecrets to read vault roles. Doing a dry-run against staging, want an extra pair of eyes before I promote.
Kevin L: Can you paste the plan output and the RBAC snippet? Also which namespace are you creating the SA in? should be the externalsecrets namespace, not kube-system.
Ashley R: Pasted plan and the k8s manifest below. It's creating `k8s_service_account.external_secrets` in namespace `external-secrets` and a RoleBinding that references vault-reader role.
```
# terraform plan snippet
+ resource "kubernetes_service_account" "external_secrets" {
+   metadata {
+     name      = "external-secrets-sa"
+     namespace = "external-secrets"
+     annotations = {
+       "redwood.com/rotation-owner" = "secrets-platform"
+     }
+   }
+ }
```
Ashley R: And the binding YAML I'm applying via k8s_manifest in TF: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: external-secrets-vault-reader
  namespace: external-secrets
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: external-secrets-sa
  namespace: external-secrets
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: vault-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Kevin L: Looks fine. Couple things: make sure vault role path mapping is scoped to the service account `external-secrets-sa@external-secrets`. Also add TTL/rotation annotation on the ExternalSecret CRs if you want faster rotation in staging.
Samir P: Quick Q about rotation: will this change break ongoing rotation jobs? If the SA identity changes we might transiently lose access during rollout. Suggest do a canary: create the SA + binding in parallel, patch one ExternalSecret to the new SA annotation, verify sync, then flip.
Ashley R: Good call. I can do the canary. Who owns the flip? cc @Kevin L :eyes:
Kevin L: I'll own the flip — I can be on standby when you promote. Also please run `kubectl get externalsecrets -n external-secrets -o=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.spec.refreshInterval}\n{end}'` to confirm rotation windows.
Ashley R: Ran the command in staging: ```
payments-credentials: 5m
webhooks-signing: 1h
svc-account-tokens: 30m
```
Ashley R: CI ran a terraform plan in the PR and the plan is clean. cc infra-bot for dry-run apply.
